description: Estimate what a JetBlue ticket earns (miles or points, and status credit where it applies), using cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

cabin.description: Cabin. main = Main; evenmore = EvenMore; bluefirst = BlueFirst; mint = Mint.

card.description: Paying with a JetBlue card. none = No; JB = JetBlue Card (+3 per $1); JP = Plus (+6 per $1); JBZ = Business (+6 per $1); JPR = Premier (+6 per $1).

direct.description: Booked on jetblue.com or the app. 1 = Yes; 0 = No (Travel agent or other site). Booking direct earns the same points again.

fare.description: Fare. base = Base (1 per $1); standard = Standard (3 per $1); flex = Flex (3 per $1). Every cabin is sold as Base, Standard or Flex.

price.description: Fare paid (before taxes and fees) in US dollars. Points and tiles are earned on the fare before taxes and fees.

status.description: Your TrueBlue status. General Member = General Member (No status); Mosaic 1 = Mosaic 1 (+3 per $1); Mosaic 2 = Mosaic 2 (+3 per $1); Mosaic 3 = Mosaic 3 (+4 per $1); Mosaic 4 = Mosaic 4 (+5 per $1).

name: calculate_jetblue_points
title: JetBlue TrueBlue Calculator
